flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Payment/{PaymentCash.tsx,action/ActionSave.tsx}, utils/mapping/Payment/Cash.ts, utils/validation/Payment/ValidCash.ts, utils/constant.ts (MANUAL_PAYMENT_MODE). ocmsadminapi workflows/payment_reduction/payment/{PaymentUpdateController,PaymentUpdateServiceImpl,PaymentValidator,dto/PaymentUpdateRequest}, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi DailyPaidReportHelper (internal report, not an interface). The word 'Cumulus' does not appear in any of the six repos.
note: Status 'Fully paid' in the sheet. Manual payment recording works: the officer fills Amount Paid, Date of Payment, Payment Mode (CASH, CHEQUE or OTHER) and Remarks, then Update calls POST /v1/updatePayment, which stores one web_txn_detail row (sender OCMS) and changes the notice status. Big gap: there is no interface to Cumulus at all (grep 'cumulus' gives 0 hits across the six repos, excluding the stale cronservice copy), and there is no receipt details field: the receipt number is generated by the system (prefix MPY) and is not shown to the officer (receipt download is commented out, PaymentCash.tsx:127-139). One notice can be recorded at a time, not several. Dangerous edge case: Amount Paid 0.00 passes UI validation (ValidCash.ts:30-33) and server validation (DecimalMin 0.00, PaymentUpdateRequest.java:49-53); an amount of 0 goes to the PARTIAL_PAYMENT path (PaymentValidator.java:91-101), so the notice becomes PS (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:316-333, 389-401). A future date is blocked only in the UI (ValidCash.ts:34-57); the server only has @NotNull (PaymentUpdateRequest.java:41-43). Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-106 (backdated Date of Payment becomes crs_date_of_suspension, PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:124, 373-383), OCMS-SR-2026-159 (the remarks column is meant for manual counter payments, PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:166), OCMS-SR-2026-190 (payment over a PS-APP notice becomes a refund, PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:98-116). User roles cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Do not claim in full. The recording part (amount, date, mode, remarks, save) can be claimed; the Cumulus interface does not exist in any repo and receipt details are not keyed by the officer. Ask URA to confirm whether Cumulus is built outside these six repos.

steps.step: Officer selects the notice(s) to record payment for
steps.detail: Payment is recorded for one Notice No. at a time via the search box (PaymentCash.tsx:148-214, 290-310). There is no multi-notice selection, and the outstanding list checkboxes do not lead to payment (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:145-152). Same fit as OCMS44.2 step 3.

Amount Paid is required, 2 decimals, prefilled with amountPayable and editable; a hint appears when it is lower or higher than the amount payable (PaymentCash.tsx:250-259, 314-339; Cash.ts:21; ValidCash.ts:30-33). The server accepts 0.00 up to 99999999999999999.99 (PaymentUpdateRequest.java:49-53), so a value of 0 passes (see note).

steps.step: Officer keys in Date of Payment
steps.detail: Date of Payment is required, date-time format, and a future date is rejected in the UI (PaymentCash.tsx:341-348; ValidCash.ts:34-57). The value is stored as transaction_date_and_time and payment_date_and_time (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:167-168). The server is only @NotNull, so the future-date rule is UI-only (PaymentUpdateRequest.java:41-43). A backdated date is used as crs_date_of_suspension (OCMS-SR-2026-106).

The Payment Mode dropdown holds codes from standardcodelist filtered by MANUAL_PAYMENT_MODE = CASH, CHEQUE, plus OTHER with free text up to 6 characters (PaymentCash.tsx:228-230, 350-382; constant.ts:163-166; ValidCash.ts:58-67; Cash.ts:31-32). The server accepts a string up to 10 characters (PaymentUpdateRequest.java:36-39). The dropdown content depends on standard code data, cannot verify from repo.

The form only has Notice No., Summon No./NTAC No., Vehicle No., Amount Paid, Date of Payment, Payment Mode, Remarks (PaymentCash.tsx:290-392) and the payload is only noticeNo, paymentMode, transactionDateAndTime, remarks, amountPaid (Cash.ts:27-41). There is no receipt field. The receipt number is generated by the server: 'MPY' + 9-digit sequence + checksum (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:160, 183-220) and is not shown; the receipt download step is commented out (PaymentCash.tsx:127-139).

The Remarks text area is limited to 200 characters (PaymentCash.tsx:384-392) and passed to web_txn_detail.remarks (PaymentUpdateRequest.java:45-47; PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:166). OCMS-SR-2026-159 confirms this column is meant for staff comments on manual payments.

steps.step: Officer saves; OCMS records the payment
steps.detail: The Update button shows a confirmation (ActionSave.tsx:52-60) and then POSTs updatePayment (PaymentCash.tsx:90-104; PaymentUpdateController.java:40-60). processPaymentUpdate (@Transactional) stores one web_txn_detail row: MPY receipt, sender OCMS, status SUCCESS, payment_mode, amount, remarks (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:83-132, 159-180), then runs the validator and updates VON/eVON (covered in OCMS44.5). The endpoint is registered under OCMS_PAYMENT_CASH (api-authorization.properties:111-112). Note: type_of_receipt is set to the ESERVICE constant for counter payments (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:165). Role authorization cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS interfaces the collection to Cumulus
steps.detail: The word 'cumulus' does not appear in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi (src), ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi or thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep, 0 hits); synonyms finance system/general ledger/collection interface also give 0. processPaymentUpdate ends after the database update (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:83-132) with no outbound call. The closest things are atoms_flag 'N' (PaymentUpdateServiceImpl.java:170) and the Offline Payments tab in the Daily Paid Report (DailyPaidReportHelper.java:166-184), an internal report and not an interface. It may be built outside these repos: cannot verify from repo.
